decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Before any work on the implementation of the retail element
    of the development hereby approved begins, full details of
    the following shall be submitted and approved by the
    Council;
    a. shop front design,
    b. means of refuse storage and collection,
    c. a scheme for the extraction of fumes,
    d. sound insulation between different uses.

Condition : 2 - The Class A3 use hereby permitted shall not be carried out
    outside the following times 09.00 to 23.00 hours Mondays to
    Saturdays and 09.00 to 22.00 on Sundays and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 3 - No construction shall take place until a detailed design and
    method statement for all foundations and other development
    proposed below ground level which takes account of London
    Underground Ltd.'s tunnels, has been submitted to and
    approved by London Underground Ltd.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until a scheme for the
    protection of the   proposed building against noise/
    vibration and elctromagnetic interferrence  from underground
    trains has been submitted to and approved by London
    Underground Ltd. And all works which form part of such a
    scheme shall be completed before any of the building hereby
    permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - No loading or unloading of goods, including fuel into the
    premises, by vehicles arriving at or  departing from the
    premises shall be carried out otherwise than within the
    curtilage of the building.

Condition : 6 - The cycle stands for the parking of 60 cycles as shown on
    drawing A-TP-00G B shall be provided before the use on site
    is commenced and shall be retained in that form thereafter.

Condition : 7 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the
    area generally in accordance with the requirements of policy
    RE* of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan
    2000.

Condition : 8 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the
    area generally in accordance with the requirements of policy
    RE* of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan
    2000.

Condition : 9 - So that London Underground Ltd. May be satisfied that the
    proposed development hereby approved adjacent to the railway
    is not a hazard to the railway .

Condition : 10 - So that London Underground Ltd. May be satisfied that the
    proposed development hereby approved adjacent to the railway
    is not a hazard to the railway .

Condition : 11 - To avoid obstruction of the surrounding streets and to
    safeguard amenities of adjacent premises. in accordance with
    the requirements of policy TR23 of the London Borough of
    Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 12 - To ensure the availability of the facilities in accordance
    with the approved scheme in order to comply with the
    requirements of TR22 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary
    Development Plan 2000

Condition : 13 - Building work shall be carried out in strict accordance with
    London Underground's "Special Conditions for Work carried
    Out Adjacent to the Railway."

Condition : 14 - Should there be any new construction below the existing
    foundations:
    No construction should take place until a detailed design
    method statement for all foundations and other development
    more than 3 metres below ground level, which takes account
    of the proposed running tunnels of the CrossRail Project,
    including any ground movement arising from the construction
    and operation of the said project, has been submitted to and
    approved by London Underground Ltd.

Condition : 15 - The Council supports schemes for the recycling of bottles
    and cans and encourages all hotels, restaurants, wine bars
    and public houses to do so as well. Further information can
    be obtained by telephoning the Council's Street environment
    Service (Recycling) on 020 7974 1553.
description:

post office sorting depot and ancillary offices, to a mixed
use development comprising a museum study centre (Class D1)
storage (Class B8), and  retail(Class A1), financial
services (Class A2) and restaurant (Class A3) use, involving
alterations and extensions

18,  A-TP- EX1, EX2, EX3, EX4
Proposed floor plans: A-TP-SB, OOB, OOG Rev. B, OGM, 01,
O1M, 02, O2M, O3, O3M, 04, 05, 06, 07, O8

TP-07, OOB, O4, OO5B
